reviews.review:
I've never played a game so meta, where the game itself becomes part of the challenge.
To understand what I'm talking about, crashing appears to be less of an issue, and more of a mechanic.
Everytime i open the game, I get 3 seconds of experiencing the very vast and immersive world of Uknon Jones Guynelk 2, before getting shut off from it entirely because it crashes. I began to be very upset over this, launching the game several times, in hopes to get it to work. For reference I have a very powerful PC, so I was very confused as to why this would happen.

Until it hit me… Im not meant to play Uknon Jones and Guy Nelk 2.

This revelation struck me very deeply. Uknon Jones must be an experience where the game itself becomes an enemy you must battle with. The most difficult enemy of all.
I can't say I've experienced a game so unique, so different.compared to literally any other game I've ever played in my life. Such a diverse experience, must be biblical. 
The challenges we overcome everyday, similar to the challenge Uknon faces when finding the Crystal Cereal to rescue his grandfather… 

We are very similar to Uknon, universally we all share different experiences, and this experience is one you could never miss out on.

If you haven't played Uknon Jones and Guynelk 2, you don't understand how to overcome challenges in your own life, allow this game to teach you. Best game ive ever played. Highly recommended.
